What's new in 0.31.0 — Watch Challenges rotate

• Finished challenges now move to a new "Completed" section at the bottom of Watch Challenges, and a new challenge takes their place in the same spot.
• Eight challenges are on the go at once.
• Six new built-in challenges: The David Fincher Files, Denis Villeneuve in Order, The Wes Anderson Collection, Best of the 70s, Best of the 90s and Ten Animated Greats.
• When Zylo's own challenges run low, new ones come from Trakt's most popular public lists (6–20 titles). Only a Trakt Client ID is needed, not a sign-in.
• Trakt lists that have nothing playable (only episodes, or nothing a kids profile's rating allows) are skipped automatically.
• Each profile now has its own active and completed challenges.
• If you were working on Best of the 80s or Around the World, they're now further down the queue and will come back when a slot opens. Your progress on them is kept.
